titulo: Quiz — The hammer sentence, and the card
introPt: A traveller makes sure an allergy reaches the kitchen, not just the table.

dialogo.es: Ho un'allergia alle arachidi. È grave.
dialogo.pt: I have a peanut allergy. It is serious.

dialogo.es: Ho capito. Lo dico in cucina.
Questo no, ma è fritto nello stesso olio.
dialogo.pt: Not this one, but it's fried in the same oil.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does allergia go first in the sentence?
opcoes: It is the word that changes what happens in the kitchen
perguntas.explica: So it goes first, not last.

perguntas.pergunta: What are you listening for in the waiter's reply?
opcoes: A repeat of the dish name
perguntas.explica: Lo dico in cucina is the answer you want; warmth alone is the default register.

opcoes: It survives noise, accents, a shift change and a dead battery
perguntas.explica: Paper works when the battery does not.

opcoes: A good answer — it names a risk the menu never prints
perguntas.explica: Same oil, same board, same water.

perguntas.pergunta: What do you do when the plate arrives?
opcoes: Confirm once before the first bite
perguntas.explica: One confirmation, not a fourth repetition.
